Generic infobox. All fields are optional and appear in a fixed order; labels can be overridden with <code>FIELD_label</code>. Extra rows can be passed as raw table rows in <code>extrarows</code>.

Fields: <code>type</code> (Type), <code>vanilla</code> (Replaces), <code>rarity</code> (Rarity), <code>renewable</code> (Renewable), <code>stackable</code> (Stackable), <code>heals</code> (Heals), <code>effects</code> (Effects), <code>intrinsics</code> (Intrinsics), <code>eat_time</code> (Eating time), <code>durability</code> (Durability), <code>damage</code> (Attack damage), <code>attackspeed</code> (Attack speed), <code>miningspeed</code> (Mining speed), <code>armor</code> (Armor), <code>toughness</code> (Armor toughness), <code>knockbackres</code> (Knockback resistance), <code>bonus</code> (Set bonus), <code>repair</code> (Repaired with), <code>tool</code> (Tool), <code>blastres</code> (Blast resistance), <code>hardness</code> (Hardness), <code>luminous</code> (Luminous), <code>health</code> (Health points), <code>attack</code> (Attack strength), <code>speedmob</code> (Speed), <code>spawn</code> (Spawn), <code>drops</code> (Drops), <code>maxlevel</code> (Maximum level), <code>slots</code> (Slots), <code>items</code> (Applies to), <code>exclusive</code> (Incompatible with), <code>obtain</code> (Obtained from), <code>biomes</code> (Biomes), <code>generates</code> (Generates in), <code>consists</code> (Consists of), <code>workstation</code> (Job site block), <code>duration</code> (Duration), <code>level</code> (Level), <code>parent</code> (Parent), <code>requirements</code> (Requirements), <code>reward</code> (Reward), <code>added</code> (Added in), <code>tooltip</code> (Tooltip lore), <code>id</code> (Resource location), <code>base</code> (Base item), <code>source</code> (Defined in)
